phrase.zh: 每条分支，都保存一次选择。

visual.zh: 多条彩色路径从同一处发散又汇合，借空间路线表现版本演进。它不是任何真实项目的提交历史。
visual.en: Colored paths split and meet, turning version history into routes through space. This is not the commit graph of a real project.

background.zh: 在 Git 中，一次提交保存内容快照并指向先前提交；普通提交通常有一个父提交，合并提交可以有多个。分支让不同工作沿各自路径发展，再选择是否合并。
background.en: In Git, a commit points to a content snapshot and earlier commits; an ordinary commit normally has one parent, while a merge commit can have more. Branches let lines of work develop separately before a possible merge.
